# brethof-llms-txt

> A Python tool that generates and maintains an llms.txt file for GitHub repositories based on existing documentation and navigation structures.

It runs on Python 3.11+ using only the standard library. It can be deployed as a GitHub App, GitHub Action, or command-line tool. It uses deterministic scripts for structure and optional models for descriptions.

## Docs

- [brethof-llms-txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/brethof-llms-txt/main/README.md): Generates and maintains llms.txt from repository docs, using deterministic structure and optional model-written descriptions.
- [How the GitHub App works](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/brethof-llms-txt/main/docs/github-app.md): Explains how the GitHub App creates, updates, and manages llms.txt files via pull requests and scheduled runs.
